name: Buy Toseina Codeine Syrup – 2mg/ml
description:
Toseina Codeine Syrup – 2mg/ml

Buy Toseina Codeine Syrup – 2mg/ml is a prescription cough medicine that contains codeine phosphate hemihydrate. It is used for the symptomatic treatment of dry, non-productive cough in adults and adolescents over 12 years of age. Toseina acts as a centrally acting cough suppressant by reducing the cough reflex in the brain

How It Works | What Toseina Is Used For

Codeine works on the central nervous system by suppressing the cough center in the brain, helping to reduce the urge to cough.

• Temporary relief of dry, irritating cough

• Symptomatic treatment of non-productive cough in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older
